name: Glamour
source: Main character (a guy or a girl, your choice) from a small town turns 18 and it’s time to go to college. Thankfully, they get an opportunity to move into big city and apply into a new experimental college. New live, new opportunities, and no oversight from an overprotective mom! Turns out main character doesn’t even have to pay for the college! All they have to do is sign a strange contract and agree to follow college rules, breaking which might have grave consequences, up to being expelled… And not only that, the rules might change in the future, too…
translation: 来自小镇的主角（男女皆可自由选择）年满18岁，迎来了升入大学的年纪。幸运的是，主角获得了迁往大城市、报读一所全新实验性大学的机会——崭新的生活、无限的机遇，还彻底摆脱了过度保护的老妈的管束！更棒的是，主角甚至连学费都不用交！唯一需要做的，只是签下一份古怪的协议，答应遵守校方制定的各项校规——一旦违规便可能招致严重后果，最高甚至会被直接开除……不仅如此，这些校规在日后还可能随时发生改变……
